quests.instruction: What do we wear that comes in matching pairs of two?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Hint: They are soft and can have fun patterns.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Wearing matching socks is fun, but wearing silly mismatched ones is fun too.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear under a sweater or jacket to stay extra warm?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: It has two sleeves for your arms.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Some shirts have buttons, and some just pull over your head.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear with two long legs that go all the way to our ankles?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: They have two long tubes, one for each leg.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Long ago, only certain people wore pants, but now almost everyone does.

quests.instruction: What do we wear when snow is falling outside our window?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Hint: It is your best friend on a snowy day.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: The longer a coat is, the more of your legs it can keep warm.

quests.instruction: What do we wear over our shirt when the house feels chilly?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: Hint: Grandparents sometimes knit these by hand.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Some families like to wear matching sweaters for winter photos.

quests.instruction: What do we wear before we go outside to build a snowman?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these to make a snowball without cold hands.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some gloves have special grippy palms for holding onto things.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of long pants when the weather is warm?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these when it is too hot for pants.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: You can play sports easily in a comfy pair of shorts.

quests.instruction: What do we wear with a fun picture or pattern printed on the front?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Hint: It often has a fun design on the front.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: You can print almost any picture or color onto a T-shirt.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that sits right on top of our hair?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Hint: You tip this to say a friendly hello.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: A hat can keep your head warm in winter or shady in summer.

quests.instruction: What do we wear right after our warm bath in the evening?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: Hint: You change into these right before a story and sleep.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Changing into pajamas is a cozy signal that bedtime is near.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that zips or buttons up the front?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Hint: It keeps the wind from making you shiver.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: A jacket is lighter than a coat but still keeps you warm.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that flows and twirls when we spin around?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Hint: It can be short or reach all the way to your ankles.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Dresses come in every color and pattern you can imagine.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that is taller and sturdier than regular shoes?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Hint: They reach up past your ankle.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Sturdy boots are perfect for hiking over rocks and mud.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that swishes gently when we walk?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: Hint: It swishes when you walk or twirl.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Some skirts are pleated, which means they have neat folds all around.

quests.instruction: What do we wear before we tie the laces or fasten the straps?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: Hint: They have soles that touch the ground.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: People have worn some kind of shoes for over ten thousand years.

quests.instruction: What do we wear when it snows and the wind feels icy?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: Hint: It keeps icy wind off your neck.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Some people wear light scarves in summer just for looking stylish.

quests.instruction: What do we wear under a dress or skirt sometimes for extra warmth?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: Hint: You wear a belt to help hold these up.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants keep your legs warm and protected when you play outside.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that buttons up the front?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: Hint: You tuck this into your pants sometimes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: A clean shirt every day helps you feel fresh and comfy.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is thicker and warmer than a jacket!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: A coat with a hood gives your head extra warmth without needing a hat.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear before we put our shoes on in the morning?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your feet before your shoes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks were one of the very first clothing items people ever knitted.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that gives our fingers a cozy, warm hug?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your hands!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some winter gloves even have special fingertips that work on phone screens.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that is light and comfy for playing outside?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has short sleeves!
quests.explanation: Super! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: T-shirts are named for their shape, which looks like the letter T!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear on a cool autumn day before winter arrives?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is soft, warm, and often knitted!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Sweaters trap warm air close to your body, which is what keeps you toasty.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear when we run and play outside in the heat?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover your legs, but only a little bit!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts come in so many lengths, from very short to almost knee-length.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear to keep warm without wearing a heavy coat?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You put this on over your shirt!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Jackets keep the cold wind out so we stay cozy!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear instead of a shirt and skirt worn separately?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is one piece that covers your whole body!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: A dress is one single piece of clothing, not two separate parts!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear when we want to keep our head warm in winter?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It sits right on top of your head!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Hats block the hot sun from our eyes!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear these to bed!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Pajamas are made extra soft and loose so you can sleep comfortably!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear to keep our feet dry in wet, muddy weather?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover more of your leg than regular shoes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Boots reach higher up your leg than regular shoes do!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that comes in two matching pairs, one for each foot?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your feet before you go outside!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Shoes protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground!
